QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] An Unlikely Source
QuestInfo.0: The World Heart reacts to the traces of Baldrix's magic. If you focus your mind on the World Heart, maybe you can absorb them.
QuestInfo.1: By absorbing Baldrix's magic, you see a vision of his past. His power is derived of the ancient gods.
QuestInfo.2: By absorbing Baldrix's magic, you saw a vision of his past. His power is derived of the ancient gods. But how is that possible?
